items.title: Direct PPTX File Ingestion
items.description: Load standard `.pptx` documents directly from local filesystem paths.

items.title: Macro-Enabled & Template Formats (.pptm, .potx, .potm, .ppsx, .ppsm, .ppam)
items.description: Ingest macro-enabled presentations, templates, slide shows, and add-ins directly into the VFS.

items.title: Legacy PPT & OpenDocument ODP Ingestion
items.description: Detect legacy binary PowerPoint (.ppt) and OpenDocument (.odp) files via signatures, normalizing slides and text into standard OpenXML.

items.title: Binary Buffer & Uint8Array Loading
items.description: Ingest presentations from in-memory Node.js `Buffer` or `Uint8Array` instances.

items.title: Stream-Based Ingestion
items.description: Pipe incoming presentations using Node.js `Readable` streams or web streams.

items.title: Remote Web URL Ingestion (`PPTXTemplater.load`)
items.description: Stream remote presentations over HTTP/HTTPS using standard fetch directly into in-memory VFS.

items.title: Cloud Object Store Ingestion (`PPTXTemplater.load`)
items.description: Directly ingest presentation streams or buffers from AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob Storage.

items.title: ZIP Archive Ingestion
items.description: Load archives with `.zip` or custom extensions by inspecting PKZip container magic bytes (`0x50 0x4B 0x03 0x04`).

items.title: Unpacked OpenXML Directory Ingestion
items.description: Ingest raw, uncompressed folder trees (containing `[Content_Types].xml`, `_rels/`, and `ppt/`) directly into memory without intermediate zip steps.

items.title: Template-Free Blank Deck Generation (`createBlank`)
items.description: Synthesize minimal valid OpenXML packages from scratch with customizable aspect ratios (16:9, 4:3, 16:10) or custom EMU/pixel dimensions.

items.title: Polymorphic Import Entrypoint (`PPTXTemplater.load`)
items.description: Single unified method accepting any supported source (path, buffer, stream, URL, cloud config, or folder) with automatic format routing.

items.title: Microsoft Flat OPC XML Ingestion (`PPTXTemplater.load`)
items.description: Ingest single-file XML packages (<pkg:package>) directly into memory, extracting XML parts from <pkg:xmlData> and decoding Base64 binary assets from <pkg:binaryData> without ZIP decompression overhead.

items.title: Slide Query & Normalized Inspection (`getSlides`, `getSlide`)
items.description: Read presentation-level and slide-level metadata (indices, slide IDs, layout paths, tags, visibility states, and dimensions).

items.title: Dynamic Slide Addition (`addSlide`)
items.description: Append or insert new slides at specific target positions with titles, layouts, and initial visual elements.

items.title: Slide Deletion (`removeSlide`)
items.description: Remove slides by 1-based index or reference without corrupting OpenXML relationship graphs or presentation manifests.

items.title: Slide Reordering & Moving (`moveSlide`, `reorderSlides`)
items.description: Dynamically reorder slides or move specific slides between positions while preserving PowerPoint section assignments.

items.title: Deep Slide Duplication (`duplicateSlide`)
items.description: Clone slides with complete visual trees, isolated relationship mappings, duplicated embedded charts/workbooks, and regenerated row IDs.

items.title: Slide Import & Export (`importSlideFrom`, `exportSlides`)
items.description: Import slides from external presentations preserving all dependencies, or export selected slides into standalone deck packages.

items.title: Section Organization (`useSection`, `addSection`, `updateSection`, `removeSection`, `getSection`)
items.description: Manage PowerPoint sections via <p14:sectionLst> extension lists with UUID tracking and member slide ID list synchronization.

items.title: Slide Visibility Control (`hideSlide`, `unhideSlide`)
items.description: Toggle slide show visibility via root <p:sld show="0|1"> attribute without altering DrawingML elements or relationships.

items.title: Canvas Reset (`resetSlide`)
items.description: Purge user-created shape trees while preserving root non-visual properties and layout placeholders.

items.title: Collaborative Slide Comments (`addComment`, `removeComment`)
items.description: Manage collaborative review comments with authors, initials, coordinate anchors, and targeted comment removal.

items.title: OpenXML EMU Normalization
items.description: Standardize internal dimensions and positions in English Metric Units (1 pt = 12,700 EMUs; 1 in = 914,400 EMUs; 1 px = 9,525 EMUs).

items.title: Coordinate & Dimension Extraction
items.description: Retrieve computed bounding boxes (`x`, `y`, `width`, `height`, `rotation`) for any slide element.

items.title: Programmatic Spatial Transformation
items.description: Reposition and resize any element using points, pixels, inches, or EMUs.

items.title: Z-Index Layer Management
items.description: Reorder element rendering hierarchy (bring to front, send to back, step forward, step backward).

items.title: Boundary & Collision Detection
items.description: Calculate element bounding intersections and detect slide edge overflows.

items.title: Slide Element Enumeration
items.description: Extract all visual elements residing on a specific slide.

items.title: Type-Based Element Filtering
items.description: Query elements filtered by type (`text`, `shape`, `image`, `table`, `chart`, `group`).

items.title: Name & ID Selectors
items.description: Query elements by their PowerPoint shape name (e.g., `Title 1`, `Picture 3`) or unique non-visual shape ID.

items.title: Template Token Selectors
items.description: Target and match text boxes, shapes, or tables bound to placeholder identifiers (e.g., `{{variable_name}}`).

items.title: AST-Level Run Normalization
items.description: Tokenize and assemble fragmented `<a:r>` and `<a:t>` nodes to eliminate broken regex replacements across XML boundaries.

items.title: In-Place Text Replacement
items.description: Replace single or multiple text values without losing surrounding paragraph formatting.

items.title: Text Run Appending & Prepending
items.description: Insert new text spans before or after existing content within any text box.

items.title: Font Family Modification
items.description: Update font family declarations across entire text frames or specific runs.

items.title: Font Size Adjustment
items.description: Modify text size in points or EMUs.

items.title: Color & Fill Modification
items.description: Apply hex colors, RGB values, or theme colors to text runs.

items.title: Typography Styling
items.description: Toggle bold, italic, underline, strikethrough, subscript, and superscript.

items.title: Paragraph Alignment
items.description: Set horizontal alignment (left, center, right, justify).

items.title: Vertical Alignment
items.description: Control text frame vertical centering, top alignment, or bottom alignment.

items.title: Line & Paragraph Spacing
items.description: Adjust line spacing, space before, and space after paragraphs.

items.title: Word Wrap Control
items.description: Enable or disable text wrapping within shape and text box boundaries.

items.title: Add Vector Shapes
items.description: Insert basic shapes (rectangles, rounded rectangles, ellipses, triangles, arrows, callouts, lines).

items.title: Solid Shape Fills
items.description: Apply solid hex/RGB color fills to any shape.

items.title: Gradient & Pattern Fills
items.description: Apply linear/radial gradients or pattern fills to shapes.

items.title: Fill Transparency & Opacity
items.description: Adjust transparency percentages on shape fills.

items.title: Shape Border & Outline Styling
items.description: Customize outline color, stroke weight, and stroke pattern (solid, dashed, dotted).

items.title: Text Inside Shapes
items.description: Insert, style, and vertically align text inside any vector shape with custom internal padding.

items.title: Remove Shape
items.description: Delete individual shapes from slides cleanly.

items.title: Insert Images
items.description: Add images from local file paths, binary Buffers, or Base64 data URIs.

items.title: Multi-Format Media Support
items.description: Support PNG, JPEG, SVG, GIF, and WebP media types.

items.title: In-Place Image Swapping
items.description: Replace template image placeholders while preserving original bounding boxes and coordinates.

items.title: Aspect Ratio Preservation
items.description: Automatically calculate and lock aspect ratios when inserting or updating images.

items.title: Image Metadata Extraction
items.description: Query image dimensions, format types, file sizes, and internal relationship references.

items.title: Remove Image
items.description: Remove media elements and clean up associated relationship pointers.

items.title: Insert Table
items.description: Add tables specifying row counts, column counts, coordinates, and default dimensions.

items.title: Table Data Hydration
items.description: Populate entire tables directly from 2D arrays or structured JSON payloads.

items.title: Row CRUD
items.description: Add, append, delete, or duplicate table rows dynamically.

items.title: Column CRUD
items.description: Add, append, or delete table columns dynamically.

items.title: Cell Target Query
items.description: Retrieve individual cells via zero-based indices (`table.getCell(rowIndex, colIndex)`).

items.title: Cell Data Modification
items.description: Update text, font, alignment, and formatting inside individual cells.

items.title: Cell Background Fills
items.description: Set solid background colors and opacity per cell or row.

items.title: Custom Cell Borders
items.description: Set individual edge borders (top, bottom, left, right) with custom thickness and color.

items.title: Horizontal Cell Merging
items.description: Merge adjacent cells across columns using `gridSpan`.

items.title: Vertical Cell Merging
items.description: Merge adjacent cells down rows using `rowSpan`.

items.title: Cell Unmerging
items.description: Split previously merged cells back into individual grid cells.

items.title: Nested Elements Inside Cells
items.description: Embed shapes, icons, badges, and small indicators directly inside table cells.

items.title: Header Row Styling
items.description: Independently target and style table header rows.

items.title: Zebra Striping
items.description: Apply automated alternating row background colors.

items.title: Table Dimensional Metadata
items.description: Extract computed table width, cumulative height, individual column widths, and row heights.

items.title: Dynamic Row Height Calculation
items.description: Compute expected row height based on cell padding, font size, line count, and column width.

items.title: Slide Overflow Detection
items.description: Compare cumulative table height against available slide height ($Y_{\text{limit}} = \text{SlideHeight} - \text{BottomMargin}$).

items.title: Automated Slide Cloning on Overflow
items.description: Clone the host template slide (including headers, footers, and background styling) when rows exceed $Y_{\text{limit}}$.

items.title: Table Row Slicing
items.description: Truncate overflowing rows on the parent slide at the last fitting index.

items.title: Header Repetition
items.description: Re-render table header rows automatically on every newly generated overflow slide.

items.title: Multi-Slide Pagination
items.description: Recursively distribute remaining table rows across subsequent slides until all records are displayed.

items.title: Summary / Footer Row Preservation
items.description: Ensure designated summary/total rows remain anchored to the final generated slide.

items.title: Target Native Charts
items.description: Select embedded PowerPoint charts by name, ID, or slide index.

items.title: Supported Chart Types
items.description: Support Bar, Column, Line, Pie, Doughnut, Area, and Scatter charts.

items.title: Chart Series Data Updates
items.description: Modify existing series data values, categories, and series labels dynamically.

items.title: Synchronous Excel Cache Updating
items.description: Update embedded `.xlsx` workbooks (`ppt/embeddings/`) alongside `<c:chartSpace>` to eliminate Microsoft PowerPoint repair prompts.

items.title: Chart Spatial Adjustment
items.description: Resize and reposition chart elements on the slide canvas.

items.title: Chart Element Toggles
items.description: Show or hide legends, data labels, category axes, and gridlines.

items.title: External Web Hyperlinks
items.description: Attach external URLs to specific text runs, entire text frames, shapes, or images.

items.title: Internal Slide Jump Links
items.description: Attach slide-to-slide navigation links (e.g., jump to a specific slide, first slide, last slide).

items.title: Hyperlink Inspection
items.description: Read existing destination URLs and internal slide targets.

items.title: Hyperlink Removal
items.description: Strip hyperlinks from elements while retaining the underlying text or shape styling.

items.title: Local File System Export (`saveToFile`)
items.description: Asynchronously serialize and write generated presentations directly to disk, creating missing parent folders automatically.

items.title: Node.js ReadableStream Export (`toStream`)
items.description: Stream presentation bytes for memory-efficient piping to AWS S3, Google Cloud Storage, or Azure Blob.

items.title: Memory Buffer Export (`toBuffer`)
items.description: Export as a native Node.js `Buffer` for in-memory processing in serverless functions.

items.title: ArrayBuffer Export (`toArrayBuffer`)
items.description: Export as a standard `ArrayBuffer` for isomorphic Node.js and modern Edge runtime compatibility.

items.title: Base64 String Export (`toBase64`)
items.description: Export as a Base64 string for JSON transfer, serverless lambdas, or webhooks.

items.title: Data URI Base64 Export
items.description: Export formatted with the presentation MIME type data URI prefix (`data:application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.presentation;base64,...`).

items.title: Express.js HTTP Pipe (`toExpress`)
items.description: Dispatch presentations directly through Express `res` objects with automatic `Content-Type` and `Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="..."` headers.

items.title: Web API Response Export (`toResponse`)
items.description: Return standard Web API `Response` objects with binary body and OpenXML headers for Next.js Route Handlers, Remix, SvelteKit, and Cloudflare Workers.

items.title: Fastify HTTP Reply (`toFastify`)
items.description: Deliver presentation buffers directly through Fastify `reply` objects with proper MIME type and Content-Disposition headers.

items.title: Direct ZIP Archive Extraction (`extractToZip`)
items.description: Package and export raw compressed ZIP archives to disk or binary buffer.

items.title: Unpacked OpenXML Folder Extraction (`extractToXml`)
items.description: Unpack all presentation parts into uncompressed folders with optional XML formatting (`formatXml: true`) for version control inspection.

items.title: Microsoft Flat OPC XML Export (`toFlatXml`)
items.description: Serialize in-memory presentations into standardized Microsoft Flat OPC single-file XML packages (<pkg:package>), encoding media assets and worksheets into Base64 <pkg:binaryData> blocks.
